map.停车配比计算器：按建筑类型配建标准计算停车位数量与面积，并含无障碍车位要求，用于: The parking ratio calculator computes the number and area of parking spaces from the provisioning standard for the building type, including accessible space requirements, for planning and application review.
map.建设工程规划许可前，按建筑类型与城市规模查\"配建停车位指标\"，计算应配建车位: Before a construction planning permit, look up the "parking space provisioning indicator" by building type and city size, then compute required spaces = building scale / unit x indicator.
map.住宅、办公、商业、酒店、医院、学校、文体场馆、公园等配建口径不同（按户/按建筑面: The provision standards for housing, offices, retail, hotels, hospitals, schools, stadiums and parks all differ (per household / per 100 m2 of floor area / per bed or seat).
map.在总车位中拆分无障碍车位（≥2%）与访客车位（按比例），并估算停车面积。: Split accessible spaces (at least 2%) and visitor spaces (by ratio) out of the total, and estimate the parking area.
map.配建指标按什么口径取值？: What basis are the provisioning indicators taken on?
map.无障碍停车位数量一般不少于总车位的 2%（且不少于 1 个），应靠近出入口、地面: Accessible parking spaces are generally not less than 2% of total spaces (and not fewer than 1), should be near entrances and on the ground. Visitor spaces are listed separately by ratio and do not count as accessible spaces.
map.→ 打开停车配比计算工具: → Open the Parking Ratio (free · browser-only · no data uploads)
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按上述口径得到的理论估算值。实际应: This tool runs entirely in the browser and does not upload inputs. Results are theoretical estimates using the method above. Actual use depends on equipment parameters, measurement conditions and local standards; refer to equipment nameplates, test reports and current standards, and consult professionals for major decisions.
map.按建筑类型提供对应指标单位（住宅按户、办公/商业/医院按每 100 m²、学校按: The tool provides the matching unit for each building type (households for residential, per 100 m² for office/commercial/hospital, per 100 students for schools, per 100 seats for cultural and sports venues, and per 1000 m² of land for parks), updating the unit and default standard when the type changes.
map.在总车位中拆分无障碍车位（≥2% 且至少 1 个）与访客车位（按比例），无障碍车: Split accessible spaces (≥2% and at least 1) and visitor spaces (by ratio) out of the total. Accessible spaces are a subset of the total, taken from regular spaces first and from visitor spaces when regular spaces are insufficient, with the actual source shown; then estimate the parking area.
map.无障碍停车位作为总车位的子集，不另加总数；数量一般不少于总车位的 2% 且至少: Accessible spaces are a subset of the total, not added on top. They are generally at least 2% of total spaces and at least 1 space, close to entrances and accessible at ground level. They are taken from regular spaces first and from visitor spaces when regular spaces are insufficient, and the page shows the actual split (“all from regular / all from visitor / regular X + visitor Y”). Even with a 0% input, the tool still returns at least 1 via max(1, ceil(...)); verify the exact ratio against local rules.
map.住宅按“户”、办公/商业/医院按每 100 m²、酒店按“客房数”、学校按每 1: Residential is counted per household, office/commercial/hospital per 100 m², hotel per guest room, school per 100 students, cultural and sports venues per 100 seats, and parks per 1000 m² of land. Indicators decrease stepwise from megacity / metropolis / medium city / small city (e.g. residential 1.0/0.8/0.6/0.5).
